title: Acorn Candy Cookies
description: This acorn candy cookies recipe is made with chocolate kisses, butterscotch chips, and vanilla wafer cookies. The cute cookies resemble little acorns.
ingredients: 24 milk chocolate candy kisses (such as Hershey's Kisses®), unwrapped
24 mini vanilla wafer cookies (such as Nilla®)

steps.text: Smear a small amount of frosting onto flat bottom of 1 candy kiss; press onto flat bottom of 1 vanilla wafer cookie. Smear a small amount of frosting onto flat bottom of 1 butterscotch chip; press onto rounded top of same cookie. Repeat with remaining frosting, candy kisses, wafer cookies, and butterscotch chips. Set aside to dry, about 30 minutes.

video.description: These no-bake cookies are adorable and easy to make. Simply attach candy kisses to vanilla wafer cookies with chocolate frosting for the cutest acorn cookies. Everyone will love this kid-friendly recipe. Who doesn’t enjoy a simple chocolate dessert?
